overview: The Council approved an appropriation from the Casino Special Revenue Fund to hire a transportation engineer, granted a Verizon underground utility petition, and passed resolutions regarding board appointments, donation drop boxes, and the Cannabis Advisory Commission.

items.title: Hearing 21-058: Verizon Grant of Location on Medford Street
items.summary: Approved a petition by Verizon New England to install an underground conduit on Medford Street crossing into Somerville, with conditions for street restoration and advance resident notice.

items.title: Resolution 21-059: Board and Commission Appointment Process
items.summary: Passed a resolution requesting an explanation of the hiring and screening processes for municipal boards and commissions, amended to include an updated online listing of vacancies, terms, and stipends.

items.title: Withdrawals: Resolutions 21-060, 21-061, and 21-062
items.summary: Vice President Knight withdrew three resolutions regarding administration updates, Cannabis Advisory Commission meetings, and Board of Health response lines after receiving the requested information.

items.title: Resolution 21-063: MWRA Memorial Field Restoration and Lighting
items.summary: Passed a resolution requesting a report from the MWRA regarding project timelines, field restoration at Memorial Field and Cradock Shell, and exploring modern lighting controls with the DCR.

items.title: Resolution 21-064: Birthday Wishes for Anna Ekpenyong
items.summary: Approved a resolution sending 96th birthday greetings to community volunteer Anna Ekpenyong.

items.title: Resolution 21-066: Fellsway Plaza Donation Drop Boxes
items.summary: Adopted a resolution asking the Building Commissioner to relocate donation bins at Fellsway Plaza away from residential abutters and hazardous driveway corners, amended to advocate for a state pedestrian crosswalk at Bradbury and Fellsway.

items.title: Resolution 21-067: Cannabis Advisory Commission Materials and Process
items.summary: Approved a request for materials, scoring rubrics, and the Mayor's filed conflict of interest disclosure regarding the Cannabis Advisory Commission, while urging commission meetings to be scheduled later in the day.

items.title: Communication 21-068: Casino Mitigation Funds for Transportation Engineer
items.summary: Approved the appropriation of $75,081 from the Casino Special Revenue Fund to establish a staff transportation engineer position to assist with traffic review and state agency coordination.

items.title: Committee Reports: 20-680, 21-047, and 20-300 / 20-302
items.summary: Adopted reports from the Committee of the Whole regarding council priorities and the hazard mitigation plan, as well as a subcommittee report advancing eviction moratorium discussions to the Committee of the Whole.
